description: Media containing diagnostic or maintenance data is not sanitized before reuse or disposal. This signal indicates that sensitive information captured during maintenance may be exposed.
applicability: Applicable to all media used during maintenance activities. Includes diagnostic logs, memory dumps, backup media, and any storage used to capture maintenance data.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through maintenance media handling procedure review, sanitization record verification, and media tracking assessment.

sources.title: 32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
